comment: Upstream watermarks for the update-patterns skill. Each entry records the last upstream commit whose behaviour was reconciled with this catalog. Update last_checked_commit only after the affected concepts were re-read and corrected (or confirmed still correct).

sources.notes: Reviewed 97d8b07..79337c5: the only change declares every package and its dependencies in mori.dhall. No source, codec, API, or version change; no catalog change.

Reconciled de574cdc..11e0bba (0.16.0.0 on Hackage and tagged; 0.17.0.0 confirmed on Hackage for all seven packages, every keiro*-0.17.0.0 tag at 11e0bba) from source, package changelogs, ADR-42, and migration 0032. Create: keiro/dead-timer-resume for guarded Dead-timer resume, inspection, and the 0032 stop-the-writers rollout. Correct: deterministic producer outbox identity and freshIntegrationEvent, required jobOrdering with FifoHeads and legacy FIFO batch rejection, guarded DLQ purge/archive and header-preserving redrive, mkPartitionSpec, pgmq 0.6/adapter 0.16 bounds and the retained effectful <2.7 bound, reaction runner and cancelTimerTx, delegated inbox, withFreshResourceStorePrepared, candidate Language 6 surfaces (process reactions, delegated intake, fifo-heads gate, declared contract IDs, nominal structural leaves, keyed maps), guard-diff advisories and diff --deny. No catalog change: CPP-gated Command.hs hydration probe, comment-only keiro-core and Metrics.hs changes, benchmarks, record-migration manifest regeneration, and 0.16 DSL no-op release. Follow-up audit re-verified every changed claim against source and upstream docs/user, the 0.16->0.17 upgrade blueprint, and previously unowned concepts: corrected the candidate-correction history, a misplaced FIFO-index sentence, the effectful-core bound wording, and the pre-existing wake_at timer example; added outbox conflict/isolation/selector-ambiguity rules, consumers-first FifoHeads rollout, claim mutation semantics, reaction timer evolution codes, nested nominal fold impact, reaction scaffold layout, 0032 stop-the-writers migration exception, foreground resume recovery, and glossary terms.
